library(kelpbio)

## Overview

The data are compiled as one dataset per kind of measurement. Column
names are fixed and carry their units (for example `diameter_mm`); any
additional columns are ignored. Some tables have columns that differ by
species, such as `weight` (e.g., `diameter_mm` vs `fronds`).

Not every dataset is required: a model without data can use a model pre-fit
to a public dataset in kelpbiodata (see [Pre-fit models](kelpbio.html#pre-fit-models)). How the datasets combine
into biomass is explained in the [Methods overview](methods.html#overview), and
how the data are expected to be collected in [Survey design](methods.html#survey-design).

## Two data format choices to highlight:

1. **Size sample or census.** A *Nereocystis* survey either measures a sample of the counted plants or all of them. With a sample, size data are provided in `size_sample`, each survey's total plant count is recorded in the `plants` column of `survey_in_situ`, and a size model is used to estimate size of unmeasured plants. If every plant is measured, sizes are recorded in the `size_census` table and each survey's total plant count is calculated automatically. For *Macrocystis*, it is assumed that all plants are measured and sizes are recorded in the `size_census` table.
2. **Site and year, or survey.** These methods are designed to estimate annual biomass at each site: the weight, size, and cover calibration models have site and year effects, and the tissue models estimate one ratio or fraction for all samples. A site can still have in situ surveys at more than one plot, or more than once in a year, and have canopy mapped more than once in a year. Each in situ survey therefore has its own `survey_id` in `survey_in_situ`, which the plants of a size census carry, and each canopy map is its own row in `survey_canopy`. However, no models estimate seasonal variation (i.e., within a year); canopy maps of the same site-year share the same biomass per m² of canopy, and in situ surveys of the same site-year share the same mean plant weight (see [Timing](methods.html#timing) for details). 

## Datasets

```{r datasets, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
# Each kind of dataset (its name without the species suffix), with what one
# row holds (kb_datasets()) and the article section on its model.
datasets <- list(
  weight = c("weight_nereo", "weight models", "methods.html#in-situ-biomass"),
  size_sample = c("size_sample_nereo", "size model", "methods.html#nereocystis-size-model"),
  size_census = c("size_census_nereo", "Censused areas", "kelpbio.html#censused-areas"),
  survey_in_situ = c("survey_in_situ", "Cover calibration", "methods.html#cover-calibration"),
  survey_canopy = c("survey_canopy", "Total biomass", "methods.html#total-biomass"),
  wetdry = c("wetdry_nereo", "Dry, carbon, and nitrogen biomass", "methods.html#dry-carbon-and-nitrogen-biomass"),
  carbon = c("carbon_nereo", "Dry, carbon, and nitrogen biomass", "methods.html#dry-carbon-and-nitrogen-biomass"),
  nitrogen = c("nitrogen_nereo", "Dry, carbon, and nitrogen biomass", "methods.html#dry-carbon-and-nitrogen-biomass")
)
lower_first <- function(x) paste0(tolower(substr(x, 1, 1)), substring(x, 2))
rows <- vapply(datasets, function(x) kb_datasets(x[[1]])$row, "")
# Kinds whose rows read the same share one bullet, as the tissue samples do.
for (row in unique(rows)) {
  kinds <- names(rows)[rows == row]
  x <- datasets[[kinds[[1]]]]
  names <- paste0("`", kinds, "`")
  if (length(names) > 1) {
    names <- paste0(
      paste(names[-length(names)], collapse = ", "),
      if (length(names) > 2) ", and " else " and ",
      names[[length(names)]]
    )
  }
  cat(sprintf(
    "- %s: one row per %s ([%s](%s)).\n",
    names, lower_first(row), x[[2]], x[[3]]
  ))
}
cat("\n")
```

Each site must be spelled the same way in every dataset: the datasets are
joined by site and year, and a misspelled site is read as a new site.

## Columns

The columns of each dataset, as given by `kb_data_columns()`.

```{r data-format, echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
html <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("&", "&amp;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("<", "&lt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
  gsub(">", "&gt;", x, fixed = TRUE)
}
ref <- function(fun) {
  paste0(
    "<a href=\"https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/",
    fun,
    ".html\"><code>",
    fun,
    "()</code></a>"
  )
}
data_format <- function(title, used_by, dataset) {
  columns <- kb_data_columns(dataset)
  row <- kb_datasets(dataset)$row
  row <- paste0(tolower(substr(row, 1, 1)), substring(row, 2))
  row <- gsub("`([^`]*)`", "<code>\\1</code>", row)
  table <- data.frame(
    Column = paste0(
      "<code>",
      columns$column,
      "</code>",
      ifelse(columns$required, "", " (optional)")
    ),
    Units = ifelse(is.na(columns$units), "", columns$units),
    Allowed = html(columns$allowed),
    Example = html(columns$example),
    Description = html(columns$description)
  )
  cat(
    "<details>\n<summary><strong>",
    title,
    "</strong>, one row per ",
    row,
    "; used by ",
    paste(vapply(used_by, ref, ""), collapse = ", "),
    "</summary>\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  print(knitr::kable(
    table,
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    row.names = FALSE,
    table.attr = "class=\"table\""
  ))
  check <- paste0("kb_check_data_", dataset)
  cat("\nChecked by ", ref(check), ".\n\n</details>\n\n", sep = "")
}

data_format(
  "Weight, *Nereocystis*",
  "kb_fit_weight_nereo",
  "weight_nereo"
)
data_format(
  "Weight, *Macrocystis*",
  "kb_fit_weight_macro",
  "weight_macro"
)
data_format(
  "Size sample, *Nereocystis*",
  "kb_fit_size_nereo",
  "size_sample_nereo"
)
data_format(
  "In situ survey",
  "kb_predict_biomass_in_situ",
  "survey_in_situ"
)
data_format(
  "Size census, *Nereocystis*",
  "kb_predict_biomass_in_situ",
  "size_census_nereo"
)
data_format(
  "Size census, *Macrocystis*",
  "kb_predict_biomass_in_situ",
  "size_census_macro"
)
data_format(
  "Canopy map",
  "kb_predict_biomass_canopy",
  "survey_canopy"
)
data_format(
  "Wet/dry",
  c("kb_fit_wetdry_nereo", "kb_fit_wetdry_macro"),
  "wetdry_nereo"
)
data_format(
  "Carbon",
  c("kb_fit_carbon_nereo", "kb_fit_carbon_macro"),
  "carbon_nereo"
)
data_format(
  "Nitrogen",
  c("kb_fit_nitrogen_nereo", "kb_fit_nitrogen_macro"),
  "nitrogen_nereo"
)
```

## Checking the data

Each dataset has a `kb_check_data_*()` function that checks the data against the format expected by the model fitting functions (e.g., column names and values) and gives an informative error message when a correction is required.
See the [data checks](https://hakaiinstitute.github.io/kelpbio/reference/index.html#data-checks) in the reference for details on the format requirements.

```{r, error = TRUE}
kb_check_data_weight_nereo(data_weight_sim_nereo)

kb_check_data_weight_nereo(data_weight_sim_nereo[, c("diameter_mm", "site")])
```
